character: smallest primitive generator g of Fp*, eta=g^((p-1)/m), eta maps to zeta_m; extension characters use norm to Fp
coefficient_ring: Z[zeta_m], exact integer pairs, zeta_m^2-s*zeta_m+1=0; s=-1,0,1 for m=3,4,6
coverage: All field elements in every listed extension for every panel and all deck characters; no all-m theorem is inferred from the finite panels.
